data.long_meaning: Derived from the Old German word 'beran', meaning 'strong' or 'bold'. The name Berne may have originated from the Old High German word 'birin', meaning 'fortified hill'. In the Middle Ages, the name was used to refer to a person from Bern, a city in Switzerland known for its strong fortifications. The name Berne carries the meaning “From the castle town” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Berne usually hope their child will grow to embody from the castle town and live with faith, good character and purpose.
